pub fn workspace_manifest() -> &'static str {
    r#"[workspace]
members = [
    \"core\",
    \"cli\",
    \"fuzz\",
    \"bench\",
]
"#
}

pub fn default_members_include_bench_or_fuzz() -> bool {
    let manifest = workspace_manifest();
    manifest.contains("\"fuzz\"") || manifest.contains("\"bench\"")
}
